mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cargo_summary ( booking_id, shipper_id, origin_unlocode, destination_unlocode, arrival_deadline, cargo_type, weight_kg, length_cm, width_cm, height_cm, quantity, product_name, hazard_imo_class, hazard_un_number, hazard_declaration, temperature_min_c, temperature_max_c, booking_status, routing_status ) VALUES ( #{bookingId}, #{shipperId}, #{originUnlocode}, #{destinationUnlocode}, #{arrivalDeadline}, #{cargoType}, #{weightKg}, #{lengthCm}, #{widthCm}, #{heightCm}, #{quantity}, #{productName}, #{hazardImoClass}, #{hazardUnNumber}, #{hazardDeclaration}, #{temperatureMinC}, #{temperatureMaxC}, #{bookingStatus}, #{routingStatus} )
mapper.update: UPDATE cargo_summary SET booking_status = #{bookingStatus}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE booking_id = #{bookingId}
UPDATE cargo_summary SET booking_status = #{bookingStatus}, routing_status = #{routingStatus}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE booking_id = #{bookingId}
UPDATE cargo_summary SET route_notified_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE booking_id = #{bookingId}
UPDATE cargo_summary SET tracking_number = #{trackingNumber}, booking_status = #{bookingStatus}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE booking_id = #{bookingId}
